event.summary: OpenRelay reported launching @OpenRelayInc: One Endpoint to Rule Them All - 100B tokens/week across 22 locations on 4 continents - 8 accelerator SKUs: NVIDIA, TPU, Trainium, AMD - Up to 20% cheaper than renting the hardware yourself Every chip on earth.
